title: Size conditions for admissible or consecutive even cycles in graphs
summary: In 2022, Gao, Huo, Liu, and Ma proved that every graph with minimum degree at least $k+1$ contains $k$ admissible cycles, where a set of $k$ cycles is said to be admissible if their lengths form an arithmetic progression with common difference one or two. In this paper, we provide a sharp size analogue of their result and characterize the extremal graphs attaining the lower bound.
